claims.claim: Independent September 2026 reporting observed Texas Instruments' Sherman SM1 300mm fab in production, with one factory operating and three additional factories planned subject to future capacity needs; SM1 wafers feed downstream processing into chips for customers including Apple, Ford, Nvidia and SpaceX.

risks.risk: Additional Sherman fabs remain demand-dependent; current operation of SM1 does not establish full-campus utilization or returns on future capacity.

unknowns.unknown: Independent reporting does not quantify SM1 utilization, incremental fab returns, or current valuation; those remain Alpha underwriting questions.

claims.claim: The independent observation that SM1 is already producing 300mm wafers provides a non-issuer execution check on the existing capacity-build thesis; the next execution test is utilization and economic return as demand determines whether later Sherman fabs are equipped and ramped.

risks.risk: Physical production validates execution progress but not sufficient demand, utilization, margin uplift, or return on invested capital.

unknowns.unknown: Current utilization, unit economics and incremental return on SM1 remain unquantified by this source.
